tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Regional Provident Fund Registration Copy, ESI Registration Copy, PAN, GST Copies

The contractor should have registered and obtained Valid License from the Labour Department, Government of Karnataka for having permitted to take up security contract works under the Provisions of Labor contract (R&A) Act 1970 and Karnataka Rules 1974

The contractor should have work experience in providing security personnels to kmf and its units/milk unions/ any dairy units at least for a minimum period of 10 years especially in kmf and its units/milk unions/ any dairy units atleast in 03 units with each unit 03 years satisfactory certificate enclosed copy.
The Bidder should have minimum turnover of Rs.2 Crores for the year 2025-26
